## Problem and change

What is broken or insufficient, and what changes? Explain why in your own words.

## Prior discussion

Link the issue/discussion, or explain why this is a small change that needs none.

## Architecture and scope

Which subsystems, protocols, or device families are affected? Why does this approach
fit the architecture? Could existing mechanisms or less code achieve the same result?

## Testing and evidence

List software checks and relevant reference comparisons. For hardware, include the
device/revision, Mac architecture, macOS and ASFW builds, configurations, what actually
worked, and logs or other evidence. State untested cases and limits of the results.

## Regression risks

Which other devices or shared behaviors could be affected, and how are they covered?
